ValidationRule.description: Prevents Internal Project Retro feedback from being submitted unless at least one feedback field is populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Submitted"),
$RecordType.DeveloperName = "Internal_Feedback",
ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "Project Retro"),
ISBLANK(Technical_Skills__c), ISBLANK(Time_Management__c), ISBLANK(Verbal_Communication__c), ISBLANK(Written_Communication__c), ISBLANK(Comments__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete at least one feedback field (Technical Skills, Time Management, Verbal Communication, Written Communication, or Comments) before submitting.
